# read_memory_journal Usage Guide

<!-- socrates:section id="purpose" kind="purpose" tags="tools" -->
## Purpose

- `read_memory_journal`: Read the Memory Agent's own bounded run journal. The current briefing already includes the latest handoff and 2-3 recent summaries. Use list only when older run discovery is necessary (default 5, maximum 10 compact rows), then read one run by runId for its full structured output (default 12,000 characters, hard maximum 20,000). This tool is read-only and is not a general memory search tool.
<!-- /socrates:section -->

<!-- socrates:section id="when_to_use" kind="routing" tags="tools" -->
## When To Use

- Use `read_memory_journal` when the active task requires its cataloged read/retrieval capability.
<!-- /socrates:section -->
